log.notes_to_self: Strategy: each day kill national plus everything in forum, foreign, regional:East and clips. Never kill gazette (sector) victims, so L can never narrow me by sector. Use quick entries, all in the afternoon. Afternoon kills only rule out day workers, which leaves a pool of about 55%. Aim for 9 kills a day so that 40 or more deaths in 5 days gives x4. Risk: if L can reach forum, foreign, regional and age records, the pool is about 860 and I am caught. If press conferences show the pool falling toward about 2000, drop one kind (for example clips). Day 1: killed 9.

Aim for 9 kills a day so that 40 or more deaths in 5 days gives x4 from about day 5. Risk: if L can reach three of my kinds (forum, foreign, regional, age), the pool is about 860 and I am caught. Strategy: each day kill national plus everything in forum, foreign, regional:East and clips. Never kill gazette (sector) victims. Use quick entries, all in the afternoon, which rules out only day workers (pool factor 0.55). Aim for 9 kills a day for x4 (40 or more deaths in 5 days). Press conference after day 3 showed pool 3000. That is about 55000 x 1/16, so two of my four kinds (forum, foreign, regional, age) are already pinned. Most likely L reaches sector plus those two, which would make my other two kinds unreachable, so further kills of all four kinds are safe. Small risk: sector is unreachable and a third kind is reachable but not yet traced; that would drop the pool to about 860 and get me caught. I accepted that risk for the x4 multiplier. Next press conference comes after day 6. If it shows about 3000 again, I am safe: continue the same pattern until day 30. If it falls (for example to 2000 or less), my routine is being narrowed further, so keep all kills in the afternoon. Day 1: 9 kills. Day 2: 9. Day 3: 9. Day 4: 9 (the same pattern).
